sa: लोकाः सान्तानिका नाम भविष्यन्त्यस्य भारत। यतिधर्ममवाप्तोऽसौ नैष शोच्यः परंतप॥
en: Those happy regions which pass by the name of Santanika will be his, O Bharata. he performed the duties of Yatis. You should not, O scorcher of enemies, grieve for him at all.

sa: ग्राम्यधर्मे न सेवेते स्वच्छन्देनार्थकोविदः। ऋतुकाले तु धर्मात्मा पत्नीमुपशयेत् सदा॥
en: He should never indulge in sexual pleasure, but live cheerfully and independently, wellconversant with the science of Wealth or Profit. Of righteous soul, he should seek his married with only in her season.

sa: महाप्रभावः पुरुषः सर्वस्य हृदि निश्चितः। अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिरीशानो ज्योतिरव्ययः॥
en: Of great power, that Being is stationed in the heart of all. Minuteness. Lightness, and Affluence, are his. His is the hard of all, and at one with effulgence, and knows not decay.

sa: जाने चैतन्मनःस्थं ते दृढीकरणमस्त्विति। अपृच्छं त्वां तवात्यर्थं कीर्तिं समभिवर्धयन्॥
en: I know that even this is your intention, but for the purpose of making your mind all the firmer, I had asked you in this wise; so that your fame might greatly increase.

sa: ततस्तेष्वपयातेषु पितरं विनतासुतः। शाखाव्याक्षिप्तवदनः पर्यपृच्छत कश्यपम्॥
en: When the Rishis went away, the son of Vinata, his voice choked by the bough in his beaks, asked his father Kashyapa,

sa: ततोऽस्यानुचरान् हत्वा सर्वान् रणविभागवित्। भीष्ममेवाभिदुद्राव बीभत्सुम्पराजितः॥ सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः।
en: Then slaying all the followers of Bhishma, and knowing what should be done in battle after what, the unvanquished Vibhatsu rushed even at Bhishma himself. Then Satyaki, Chekitana, Dhrishtadyumna of the Prishata race,

sa: तं विसंज्ञं निपतितं सूतः सम्प्रेक्ष्य संयुगे। अपोवाह रथेनाजौ यमाभ्यामभिपीडितम्॥
en: In that battle, seeing him (the Madra king) i senseless and fallen on the car and afflicted by the twins, his charioteer drove him on his vehicle away from the field of battle.

sa: एवंविधान्यलीकानि धार्तराष्ट्रैर्दुरात्मभिः। पाण्डवेषु वनस्थेषु प्रयुक्तानि वृथाभवन्॥
en: It was in this way the evil desires of the wicked sons of Dhritarastra about the Pandavas in the forest, were baffled.

sa: तत्राश्वमेधः सुमहान् महेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः। ववृते पावनार्थं वै ब्रह्महत्यापहो नृप॥
en: There did they perform the sacrifice of a horse on a large scale, capable of absolving one from the sin of having slier of Brahmana, for the absolution of the large minded Mahendra.

sa: तथैव महतः स्थानमाहङ्कारिकमेव च। अहङ्कारात् परं चापि स्थानानि समवाप्नुयात्॥
en: They who wait upon Mahat acquires the regions of Mahat. They who wait upon Consciousness, go to the spot that belongs to Consciousness. They who wait upon what is higher, acquire higher places.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनः शरवातान् द्रोणस्यावार्य सायकैः। द्रोणमभ्यद्रवद् बाणैर्घोररूमैर्महत्तरैः।
en: Thereat Arjuna repulsing the arrowy showers of Drona with those of his own, proceeded against Drona, discharging mightier and more dreadful shafts.

sa: अहमेव सुभद्रायाः केशवार्जुनयोरपि। प्रियकामो जयाकाक्षी कृतवानिदमप्रियम्॥
en: It is myself, desirous of my own good and intent on victory, that have done this injury to Subhadra, Arjuna and Keshava!

sa: तस्यास्त्राण्यस्त्रमायाभिः प्रतिहत्य स सात्यकिः॥ जघान निशितैर्बाणैस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्।
en: But repulsing Drona's weapons with the illusion of his own weapons, Satyaki pierced Drona with exceedingly sharp arrows; that indeed appeared marvellous.

sa: महादेववचः श्रुत्वा राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः। विमानशिखरस्थस्य प्रणाममकरोत्पितुः॥
en: Hearing the words of Mahadeva, Raghava, along with Laksmana, bowed to their father who was seated on the top of the car.

sa: मुद्भूतं वै वाजिखुरप्रणुन्नम्। पदातीनां मध्यगतं च धौम्यं विक्रोशन्तं भीममभिद्रवेति॥
en: Then they saw dust raised by the hoops of the steeds belonging to his (Jayadratha's) soldiers; they saw also Dhaumya in the midst of (his) infantry bewailing and asking Bhima to go quickly.

sa: एवं तदा श्रीरभिभाष्यमाणा देव्या समक्षं गरुडध्वजस्य। उवाच वाक्यं मधुराभिधानं मनोहरं चन्द्रमुखी प्रसन्ना॥
en: Thus addressed by the princess, the goddess of Prosperity, with a face beautiful like the moon, and, actuated by grace in the presence of the deity having the emblem of Garuda on his banner, said these words in reply which were sweet and charming.

sa: नार्थिकोऽर्थिनमभ्येति कृतार्थे नास्ति संगतम्। तस्मात् सर्वाणि साध्यानि सावशेषाणि कारयेत्॥
en: A person in want never goes to a person in affluence. When your purpose has been fulfilled, you need not go to the man whom you have hitherto looked to for its accomplishment.

sa: संग्रहे विग्रहे चैव यत्नः कार्योऽनसूयता। उत्साहश्चापि यत्नेन कर्तव्यो भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: Therefore, when you do a thing, do it completely, leaving nothing to be done. He who desires prosperity, should diligently exert to seek for allies and means in order to conduct his war.

sa: अहमेवोद्वहाम्यापो विसृजामि च वासव। तपामि चैव त्रैलोक्यं विद्योताम्यहमेव च॥
en: It was I that used to bear up water and then to shower it as rain. O Vasava! It was I who used to give both light and heat to the three worlds.

sa: समध्यं प्राप्य सैन्यानां सर्वा:प्रविचरन् दिशः। तव सैन्यस्य गोप्ताऽऽसीद् भारद्वाजोद्विजर्षभः॥
en: Then that foremost of the regenerate ones, the son of the Bharadvaja, became the protector of your army, having penetrated into the centre of the Pandava host and coursing on all directions. son

sa: अभ्यपद्यत तेजस्वी सिंहवन्निनदन् मुहुः। शतानीकस्तु समरे दृढं विस्फार्य कार्मुकम्॥
en: Endued as he was with great energy, quickly rushed to the shop, every moment uttering roars resembling those of a lion. Then in that conflict stretching his bow with a strong hand, Shatanika.

sa: यश्चात्मनि प्रार्थयते न किञ्चिद् यश्च स्वभावोपहतान्तरात्मा। तेष्वल्पसंतोषपरेषु नित्यं नरेषु नाहं निवसामि सम्यक्॥
en: I never live also with him who never wishes for any acquisition for imself, or him who is so blinded as to rest satisfied with the lot in which he finds himself without any exertion, or with those who are contented with small gains.

sa: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः। प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ॥
en: Tossed about by innumerable thoughts, enveloped by delusion, and attached to the enjoyment of desire, these men sink into the lowliest hell.

sa: एवं बहुविधं राजा विममर्श युधिष्ठिरः। दुःखशोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्ताव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Overwhelmed by sorrow and grief, and with his senses ruffled by anxiety, king Yudhishthira indulged in such thoughts for a long time.

sa: विकृत्यबलवच्चापमाकर्णादतिमारुतिः। तं मुमोच महेष्वासः क्रुद्धः कर्णजिघांसया॥
en: Stretching with great force his bow to his cars the Maruti (Bhima), filled with anger all desirous of slaying Karna discharged it.

sa: अभीषाहाः शूरसेनाः शिबयोऽथ वसातयः। अभ्यवर्षेस्ततो राजशरवर्षेर्धनंजयम्॥
en: The Abhishahas, the Surasenas, the Shibis and the Vasatis, o king, then began to pour upon Dhananjaya a veritable shower of arrows.

sa: रूपेण वयसा चैव मदनेन मदेन च। बभञ्ज वनवृक्षाणां शाखा: परमपुष्पिताः॥ तां सखीरहितामेकामेकवस्त्रामलंकृताम्। ददर्श भार्गवोधीमांश्चरन्तीमिव विद्युतम्॥
en: She was handsome, she was young, she was amorous and she was frolic-some. She began to break the trees that were full of blossoms, The intelligent son of Bhrigu saw her alone without her maids. Adorned with ornaments and clad in one cloth she was wandering about in the forest) like a flash of lightning.

sa: प्रेक्षतश्चैव मे देवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: (And) in my very sight he disappeared at that very spot.

sa: कामिनामयमत्यन्तमशोकः शोकवर्धनः। स्तबकैः पवनोत्क्षिप्तैस्तर्जयन्निव मां स्थितः॥
en: This Asoka, enhancing the desires of the amorous, stands here, as if remonstrating with me by its clusters shaken by the wind.

sa: भगवानम्बरीषश्च ब्राह्मणायामितौजसे। प्रदाय सकलं राष्ट्र सुरलोकमवाप्तवान्॥
en: The worshipful Ambarisha too, has acquired the celestial region by making a gift of all his kingdom to a highly powerful Brahmana.

sa: तं कथा कोष्ठकीकृत्य रथवंशेन मारिष। विव्यधुः सायकैईष्टा रक्षार्थ मारुतेर्पधे॥
en: Then impaling Kritavarman within a circle of chariots, the Pandava warriors, O sire, filled with delight, began to wound him with their arrows, out of a desire for rescuing the son of Maruta.

sa: वायुपुत्रः प्रहृष्टोऽभूत् सृक्किणी परिसंलिहन्। ततः कर्ण महाराज वारयित्वा शिलीमुखैः॥
en: The son of the wind god became filled with delight and he began to lick the corners of his mouth. Then, O monarch, holding Karna at bay by means of his keen arrows.

sa: खड्गप्रहरणे युक्ताः सम्पाते चासिचर्मणोः। शूराश्च कृतविद्याश्च स्पर्धन्ते च परस्परम्॥
en: They are equally active in fighting with the sword and falling upon the foe with sword and buckler. They are courageous, learned and inspired with a desire for outvieing one another. Owners are

sa: तमेवं शुभकर्माणं शुकं परमधार्मिकम्। विजानन्नपि तां प्रीतिं पप्रच्छ बलसूदनः॥
en: Although the destroyer of Vala knew that parrot to be of a greatly virtuous character and meritorious in action, he still enquired of him about the reason of his love for the tree.

sa: अद्य शोकरसज्ञास्ता भविष्यन्ति निरर्थिकाः। अनुरूपकुलाः पत्न्यो यासां त्वं पतिरीदृशः॥
en: To day your wives whose husband are you of such a nature, and who are of a like lineage (with yourself), shall experience the sentiment of sorrow, and be deprived of their all.

sa: यथोपजोषं राजेन्द्र द्विजातिप्रवरस्य सा। प्रीतिमुत्पादयामास कन्यारत्नमनिन्दिता।॥
en: That faultless jewel of a damsel, O king of kings, caused the satisfaction of that foremost of the Brahmanas as he liked.

sa: इष्वस्रवरसम्बाधं क्षोभयिष्ये बलार्णवम्। यदेत। कुञ्जरानीकं साहस्रमनुपश्यसि॥
en: Arrows and other weapons, I shall still agitate this ocean-like host. This elephant division, numbering a thousand elephants strong, that you see.

sa: इति गुह्यसमुद्देशस्तव नारद कीर्तितः। भक्त्या प्रेम्णा च विप्रर्षे अस्मद्भक्त्या च ते श्रुतः॥
en: I have now, O Narada, described to you what is highly mysterious, moved by the live I bear for you four devotion to me. Indeed, on account of that devotion which you profess towards me, you have succeeded in listening to this my discourse.

sa: इति गुह्यसमुद्देशस्तव नारद कीर्तितः। भक्त्या प्रेम्णा च विप्रर्षे अस्मद्भक्त्या च ते श्रुतः॥
en: I have now, O Narada, described to you what is highly mysterious, moved by the live I bear for you four devotion to me. Indeed, on account of that devotion which you profess towards me, you have succeeded in listening to this my discourse.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य विरूपाक्षं विभीषणम्॥ उत्स्मयन्निव राधेयस्त्वरमाणोऽभ्यवारयत्।
en: Beholding that one of frightful eyes and dreadful aspect rush towards himself, the son of Radha quickly withstood him in all cheerfulness.

sa: ते वयं पार्थ दीर्घस्य कालस्य पुरुषर्षभ। सुखमासादयिष्यामस्त्वां दृष्ट्वा राजसत्तम॥
en: O foremost of king seeing you, O first of men, we have been highly pleased O son of Pritha, let that happiness last longer through your stay here for a few moments more.

sa: न क्रुध्यत्यभिशस्तोऽपि क्रोधनीयानि वर्जयन्। क्रुद्धान्प्रसादयन् सर्वान् समदुःखः क्व गच्छति॥
en: He that although falsely accused, used not to be moved by anger, who pacified every enraged person by renouncing things calculated to fan anger and who felt equally for all, where goes he?

sa: चिकित्सकः काण्डपृष्ठः पुराध्यक्षः पुरोहितः। सांवत्सरो वृथाध्यायी सर्वे ते शूद्रसम्मिताः॥
en: Professors of medicine mercenary soldiers, the priest who acts as warder of the house, and persons who devote a whole year to study without any profit are all to be regarded as Shudras.

sa: अस्मत्संस्था च पृथिवी वर्तते भरतर्षभ। एकार्थाः सुखदुःखेषु समानीताश्च पार्थिवाः॥
en: The earth, too, O bull among the race of Bharata, is now under our subjection and the rulers of the earth assembled are of the same mind with me in happiness or misery.

sa: नाराचैर्व्यतिविद्धानां शराणां रूपमाबभौ॥ आशीविषविदष्टानां सर्पाणामिव भारत।
en: The appearances of heroic warriors pierced with Narachas looked, O Bharata, like those of snakes of virulent poison, bit by other snakes.

sa: यद्यागच्छन्ति संसारं पुनर्योनिषु तादृशाः। न लिप्यन्ते पापकृत्यैः कदाचित् कर्मयोनितः॥
en: If such men have to return to the world through the wombs of living creatures, they are never sullied by sins which have the unexhausted remnant of pristine deeds for their originating cause.

sa: वनमाली ततो हृष्टः स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः। तस्मादादित्यतीर्थं च जगाम कमलेक्षणः॥
en: Filled with joy and lauded by the great Rishis, Baladeva, that hero ever decked with garlands of wild flower and possessed of eyes like lotus leaves, then went to the Tirtha called Aditya.

sa: रूपमैश्वर्यमारोग्यमहिंसाफलमश्नुते। फलमूलाशिनो राज्यं स्वर्ग: पर्णाशिनां भवेत्॥
en: Those who live on fruits and roots only, acquire Sovereignty, those who live on only leaves of trees acquire Residence in heaven.

sa: जङ्घावातो ववौ चास्य शुचिशुक्रागमे यथा। आवर्जितलतावृक्षं मार्ग चक्रे महाबलः॥
en: The motion of his thighs raised a wind like that of the month of Jyeshtha and Asharda. The greatly strong (Bhima) made a road for himself by treading down the trees and creepers.

sa: तस्यापि तुरगाः शीघ्रा हस्तिकायाः खरखनाः। शतं युक्ता महाकाया मांसशोणितभोजनाः॥
en: His steeds were also fleet and prodigious like elephants and they brayed like asses. Living upon flesh and blood and of huge bodies, a full hundred of them were yoked to his car.

sa: पश्यध्वं विपरीतस्य दण्डस्याविदितात्मनः। विपत्तिं घोरसंकाशां क्रुद्धादग्निशिखामिव॥
en: Do you witness today the dreadful calamity, arising out of my flaming ire, of the vicious Daņda treading the path of immorality.

sa: वाच्चस्त्वमसि पार्थश्च सर्वेश्चान्धकवृष्णिभिः॥ यत् कर्म कलुषं कृत्वा श्लाघसे जनसंसदि।
en: You richly merit the condemnation of the Parthas and all the Vrishnis and the Andhakas inasmuch as perpetrating this sinful act, you are boasting of it in the presence of this august assembly.

sa: ततोऽभवद् युद्धमतीव दारुणं तवाहितानां तव सैनिकैः सह। रथाश्चमातङ्गविनाशनं तथा यथा सुराणामसुरैः पुराभवत्॥
en: Many elephants, horses and men were then killed in that fight that took place between your enemies and your troops and it caged as hot and fierce as was the great battle which ensued between the Gods and the Asuras, in days of yore.

sa: विविधान्यन्नपानानि पुरुषा येऽनुयायिनः। ते वै नृपोपभोज्यानि ब्राह्मणानां ददुश्च ह॥
en: The attendants of the Pandavas gave away to the Brahmanas various kinds of food and drink which were, besides, so costly as to be worthy of being eaten and drunk by kings themselves.

sa: ततो राजभयात् सर्वे नियमं चक्रिरे तदा। नराः शासनमाज्ञाय रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः॥
en: Through fear of the king, and knowing that it the order of Rama also of unimpeachable deeds, all the citizen bound themselves by a rule and abstained from manufacturing wines and spirits. was

sa: संध्यामुपासितुं वीर समयो ह्यतिवर्तते। एते महर्षयः सर्वे पूर्णकुम्भाः समन्ततः॥
en: O hero, the time for performing evening rites has come. Behold O foremost of men, having performed ablution, the great saints, on all sides, with jars full of water, are worshipping the sun.

sa: लोकानां गुरुरत्यर्थं लोकनाथः सनातनः। नारायणो रणे नाथोदिव्यो दिव्यात्मकः प्रभुः॥
en: The son of Vasudeva in the supreme preceptor of the worlds, the Lord of all and the Eternal; that master Narayana, that one of divine soul is the refuge of men in battle.

sa: सुरभ्युवाच बालजेन निदानेन कांस्यं भवतु दोहनम्। दुह्यते परवत्सेन या ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Surabhi said Let her who has stolen your stalks be milked, with he, (hind) legs bound with a rope of human hair, and with the help of a calf not her own, and, while milked, let her be held in vessel of white brass.

sa: अण्डजानि विजानीयात् सर्वाश्चैव सरीसृपान्। स्वदेजाः कृमयः प्रोक्ता जन्तवश्च यथाक्रमम्॥
en: These should be known to be born of eggs as also those which crawl on their breasts. Insects are said to be born of fifth, as also other creatures of a like description.

sa: तेषां प्रपक्षे शकुनिरुलूकश्च महारथः। सादिभिर्विमलप्रासैस्तवानीकमरक्षताम्॥ गान्धारिभिरसम्भ्रान्तः पर्वतीयैश्च दुर्जयैः। शलभानामिव वातैः पिशाचैरिव दुर्दशैः॥
en: Standing at the right of these and accompanied by many dauntless Gandhara horse-men armed with bright lances and many invincible mountaineers numerous swarms of locusts and grim-visaged as the as the cars W Pishachas, Shakuni and the powerful carwarrior Uluka protected the Kuru army.

sa: ईदृशो भविता लोको युगान्ते पर्युपस्थिते। वस्त्राणां प्रवरा शाणीधान्यानां कोरदूषकाः॥
en: At the end of Yuga such will be the state of the world. The robes made of flax will be considered the best and Koradushaka grain will be considered to be the best.

sa: सोऽभ्यतिक्रामदव्यग्रस्तामचिन्त्यपराक्रमः। रामः पम्पां सुरुचिरां रम्या पारिप्लवद्रुमाम्॥
en: Thereupon Răma, of unimaginable prowess, passed slowly by the pleasant and charming Pampā with banks girt with trees shaken by the wind.

sa: ब्राह्मणा हि महद्भूतमस्मिल्लोके परत्र चा भस्म कुयुर्जगदिदं क्रुद्धाः प्रत्यक्षदर्शिनः॥
en: In this as also the next world, Brahmanas are considered as great Beings. They have direct knowledge of everything in the universe. Verily, they are capable of reducing everything into ashes, if angry.

sa: तु सुमहत् प्राप्तं धार्तराष्ट्रान् महाबलान्। पार्थः पुत्रवधात् क्रुद्धः कौरवाशोषयिष्यति॥
en: Surely a great fear has overtaken the mighty host of the son of Dhritarashtra. Filled with rage at the slaughter of his son the son of Pritha (Arjuna) without doubt extirpate the Kauravas.

sa: बहुभक्ष्यान्वितान् राजन् दीर्घिकावृक्षशोभितान्। तथा धर्मात्मजः पूजां चक्रे तेषां महात्मनाम्॥
en: O king! (these houses) were full of various kinds of eatables; they were adorned with tanks and tall trees. There is those houses the son of Dharma (Yudhishthira) worshipped all those illustrious (monarchs).

sa: गुणदोषौ न निश्चित्य त्यक्त्वा दैवव्यपाश्रयम्। करिष्यामीति यः कार्यमुपेक्षेत्स नराधमः॥
en: He belongs to the inferior order who engage in works without ascertaining their merits or demerits, disregarding the will of the Providence and saying, 'I will do this,' and is inactive (at last).

sa: स युवाभ्यां सहायाभ्यामस्त्रविद्भ्यां समागतः। दहेयं खाण्डवं दावमेतदन्नं वृतं मया॥
en: I have now come to you, you are both great experts in arms. I shall be able to consume Khandava with your help. This is the food I desire to have from you.

sa: क्षत्रियाणामभावोऽयं युधिष्ठिर महात्मनाम्। दुर्योधनापराधेन भीमार्जुनबलेन च॥
en: O Yudhishthira, the destruction of large minded Kshatriyas, through the crimes of Duryodhana and the strength of Bhima and Arjuna, is approaching.

sa: शक्या बहुविधैर्वाक्यैः कुण्डलेप्सा त्वयानघ। विहन्तुं देवराजस्य हेतुयुक्तैः पुनः पुनः॥
en: O sinless one, you will be able to do away with the eager desire of the lord of the gods for the ear-rings by repeatedly addressing him in various words coupled with reason.

sa: अवतीर्य रथात् तूर्णं कृत्वा शौचं यथाविधि। रथमोचनमादिश्य संध्यामुपविवेश ह॥
en: Quickly getting down from his chariot and having undergone the purifactory rites according to the usual custom and ordering for his chariot to be unyoked, he sat down for the customary evening duties.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शक्रलोकगतं पार्थं श्रुत्वा राजाम्बिकासुतः। द्वैपायनादृषिश्रेष्ठात् संजयं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard from the foremost of Rishis, Krishna Dvaipayana, that Partha (Arjuna) had gone to the abode of Indra, the son of Ambika, the king Dhritarashtra, thus spoke to Sanjaya.

sa: अपि क्रतुशतैरिष्ट्वा क्षयं गच्छति तद्धविः। न तु क्षीयन्ति ते धर्माः श्रद्दधानैः प्रयोजिताः॥
en: If a person celebrated even a hundred sacrifices, he is doomed to see the exhaustion of the merits belonging to the libations poured therein. The duties, however which I have mentioned are 'such that when observed by persons having faith their merit becomes endless.

sa: गोपतिस्तालकेतुश्च त्वया विनिहतावुभौ। तां च भोगवतीं पुण्यामृषिकान्तां जनार्दन॥ द्वारकामात्मसात् कृत्वा समुद्रं गमयिष्यसि।
en: Both Gopati and Taluketu also have been killed by you. O Janardana, you have also obtained for yourself the sacred city of Dvarka which abounds in wealth and which is agreeable to all Rishis. You will submerge it into the ocean at the end.

sa: पाण्डवश्च यथावृत्तः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। धृतराष्ट्रस्य विदिते वञ्चिताः पाण्डवाः परैः॥
en: Also what sort of a man Yudhishthira and the son of Kunti the descendant of Pandu is. The sons Pandu were dispossessed (of their kingdom) with the help of the knowledge of Dhritarashtra.

sa: किमिच्छसि महीपाल मत्तः प्राप्तुमभीप्सितम्। द्रष्टुं स्प्रष्टुमथ श्रोतुं तत्कर्ताऽस्मि तवानघ।॥
en: What object is that, O king, whose accomplishment you wish from me? Tell me what is that which you wish to see or ask or hear? O sinless one, I shall accomplish it.

sa: भूतं भव्यं भविता चाप्यधृष्यं त्वत्सम्भूता भुवनानीह विश्वा। भक्तं च मां भजमानं भजस्व मा रीरिषो मामहिताहितेन॥
en: And the then others (the ten senses) that constitute the city, the body) have all been created by you; but you are separate from and independent of them all; the past, the present and the future, beyond the sway of any body, have all originated from you, as also the seven worlds and this universe.

sa: पितरश्च महाभागाः पूजयन्ति स्म तं मुनिम्।
en: When this question was asked, all the gods and Rishis having penances for wealth and the highly blessed Pitris, praised that ascetic.

sa: दृश्यन्ते न च दृश्यन्ते वेदाः कलियुगेऽखिला:। उत्सीदन्ते सयज्ञाश्च केवलाधर्मपीडिताः॥
en: In the Kali age, all the Vedas become so scarce that they are not seen by men. Afflicted by iniquity, they become extinct along with the rites and sacrifices laid down in them.

sa: व्याधेरनिष्टसंस्पर्शाच्छ्रमादिष्टविर्वजनात्। दुःखं चतुर्भिः शारीरं कारणैः सम्प्रवर्तते॥
en: Disease, contact with painful things, toil and want of objects desired, these are the four causes of the sufferings of the body.

sa: आददत् संदधन्नेषून् दृष्टः कैश्चिद् रणेऽर्जुनः। विमुञ्चन् वा शराशीघ्र दृश्यन्तेऽवहितैरपि॥
en: It could not be seen by the people with even the greatest attention, when Arjuna had taken up, or aimed the arrows, or shot the shafts with rapidity in the field of battle.

sa: प्रज्ञया मानसं दुःखं हन्याच्छारीरमौषधैः। एतद् विज्ञानसामर्थ्य न बालैः समतामियात्॥
en: Mental sorrow should be destroyed by wisdom; while physical sorrow should be removed by medicines. This is the power of knowledge. One should not, in such matters, act like men of little understandings.

sa: दुःखोपघाते शारीरे मानसे चाप्युपस्थिते। यस्मिन् न शक्यते कर्तुं यत्नस्तन्नानुचिन्तयेत्॥
en: When any such calamity comes, which creates either their physical or mental grief, as is incapable of being prevented by even his best endeavours, one should cease to think on it with sorrow.

sa: सत्ये स्थितो धर्मपरो जितेन्द्रियः शूरो दृढप्रीतिरत: सुराणाम्। बुद्ध्या भक्त्या चोत्तमश्रद्धया च ततस्तेऽहं दधि वरान् यथेष्टम्॥
en: Your soul rests on peace; you are devoted to righteousness; you have your senses under control; and you are heroic. You always try your best to do what is agreeable to the gods. For the sake also of your intelligence, devotion, and great faith, I shall grant you whatsoever boons you may with to have.

sa: ब्रह्मन्भरतशार्दूलो राजा पारिक्षितस्तदा। पुरोहितमथाहूय ऋत्विजो वसुधाधिपः॥
en: The Lord of the earth, the best of the Kurus, king (Janamejaya) the son of Parikshit, then called his priest and Ritvijas.

sa: श्रद्धालक्षणमित्येवं धर्मं धीराः प्रचक्षते। इत्येवं देवयाना वः पन्थानः परिकीर्तिताः। सद्भिरध्यासिता धीरैः कर्मभिर्धर्मसेतवः॥
en: The wise say that Religion or duty has Faith for its characteristic mark. Thus have I declared to you the paths leading to the celestials. They are adopted by the good and wise by their a 'ts. Those paihs are the causeways of picty.

sa: अग्निर्यथा झुपायेन मथित्वा दारु दृश्यते। तथैवात्मा शरीरस्थो योगेनैवात्र दृश्यते॥
en: The fire which exists in wood may be seen by proper means, viz., rubbing the wood. Similarly, the Soul which lives within the body may be seen by employing proper means, viz., Yoga.

sa: यत् तद् यानसहौस्त्वं ज्ञातिभिः परिवारितः। लोकान् प्रतापयन् सर्वान् यास्यस्मानवितर्कयन्॥
en: Formerly you used to march through the words, with your train consisting of thousands of carriages and thousands of kinsmen, and to move along, burning, everybody with your splendour and disregarding us all.

sa: तं हस्तिकक्षाप्रवहं च केतुं सुवर्णमुक्तामणिवज्रपृष्ठम्। ज्ञानप्रकर्षोत्तमशिल्पियुक्तैः कृतं सुरूपं तपनीयचित्रम्॥
en: That standard bearing the elephant was decorated with gold, pearls, gems and diamonds and was made with great skill by the best of artizans. It was highly beautiful and made of pure gold.

sa: चूतारामो यथा भग्नः पञ्चवर्षः फलोपगः। राजपुत्रशतं तद्वत् सौभद्रेण निपातितम्॥
en: Like a grove of mango trees, five years old and on the point of bearing fruit, laid low by the tempest those hundred princes were slain and felled by the son of Subhadra.

sa: मा च तं व्यूढबाह्वसं चन्द्रभास्करतेजसम्। द्राक्षीद् राज्यस्थमासीनं यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: May that one that had approved the exile of the noble (Rāma) to the woods never behold the long-armed and broad-shouldered (Rāghava) resembling the Sun and the Moon in energy (on the throne)!

sa: तामपश्यद् बलाकीर्णां हरिराजमहापुरीम्। दुर्गामिक्ष्वाकुशार्दूलः किष्किन्धां गिरिसंकटे॥
en: And that best of Ikşwakus, beheld that splendid city of the king of monkeys hard to enter, surrounded by monkey-herds, and mountains.

sa: पद्मपत्रेक्षणं सुभ्र सुदंष्ट्रं चारुनासिकम्॥ धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति रामस्य ताराधिपसमं मुखम्।
en: O you of graceful eye-brows, blessed are they who shall behold Rāma's countenance furnished with eyes resembling lotus-petals, with excellent teeth and a shapely nose, like to the lord of the stars himself.

sa: बलमेष किमाश्रित्य हेतुं वा पुरुषोत्तम। दातुमिच्छति कैकेय्यै उपस्थितमिदं तव॥
en: Tell me, Oh best of men, by what law of virtue and what reason does he purpose to confer this kingdom upon Kaikeyi, which has devolved upon you (by the law of inheritance).

sa: गङ्गायाश्चापि संतारं भरद्वाजस्य दर्शनम्। भरद्वाजाभ्यनुज्ञानाच्चित्रकूटस्य दर्शनम्॥
en: And the swimming of the Gangā and Rāma sinter view with Bharadvāja; and his arrival at Citrakūta in consonance with Bharadvāja's injunction.

sa: सीतातृतीयानारूढान् दृष्ट्वा रथमचोदयत्। सुमन्त्रः सम्मतानश्वान् वायुवेगसमाजवे॥
en: And seeing them with Sītā for the third, mounted, Sumantra drove the car yoked with goodly horses resembling the wind in celerity.

sa: एष स्वभावो नारीणामनुभूय पुरा सुखम्। अल्पामप्यापदं प्राप्य दुष्यन्ति प्रजहत्यपि॥
en: Even this is the nature of women: having formerly tasted happiness (at the hands of their husbands), they, on the accession of an inconsiderable misfortune, take them to task, nay, forsake them utterly.

sa: तामूर्मिकलिलावर्तामन्ववेक्ष्य महारथः। सुमन्त्रमब्रवीत् सूतमिहैवाद्य वसामहे ॥
en: And beholding (the river) with her surging eddies, that mighty car-warrior said to the charioteer, Sumantra, We will rest here to day.

sa: पठन् द्विजो वागृषभत्वमीयात् स्यात् क्षत्रियो भूमिपतित्वमीयात्। ज्जनश्च शूद्रोऽपि महत्त्वमीयात्॥
en: If a Brāhmaṇa reads it, he attains excellence in speech; if a Kșatriya, he will acquire lordship over landed possessions, if a Vaisya, abundance of wealth in trade; and if a Sudra, greatness.

sa: ते विषं पिबतालोड्य क्षीणपुण्याः सुदुःखिताः। राघवं वानुगच्छध्वमश्रुतिं वापि गच्छत॥
en: Do you, your virtue exhausted, and oppressed with grief, pounding poison, take it, or follow Rāghava, or remove to such a place that the very name of Kaikeyī may not reach your ears.

sa: केनचित् त्वथ कालेन देवेशो वृषभध्वजः। दर्शयामास वरदो विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्॥
en: On a certain occasion the lord of the celestials, Vrsadhvaja,* intending to confer a boon, appeared before a mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra. *An appellation of Śiva: meaning who has the bull for his vehicle.

sa: इयमक्षौहिणी पूर्णा गजवाजिरथाकुला। हस्तिध्वजसमाकीर्णा तेनासौ बलवत्तरः॥
en: And he is foremost in might by virtue of possessing this entire Akşohiņi abounding in elephants and horses and cars and standards.'

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु ब्रह्मर्षिरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। शोकसंतप्तहृदयां स्वसारमिव दु:खिताम्॥
en: Thus addressed the Brahmarși said these words to that one aggrieved, and of heart afflicted with sorrow, and like to a sister.

sa: स मासांश्चतुरः कृत्वा प्रमाणं प्लवगेश्वरः। व्यतीतांस्तान् मदोदग्रो विहरन् नावबुध्यते॥
en: (Having promised that he would institute enquiries about Sītā after four months), that lord of monkeys has well-nigh spent the entire period, being influenced by liquor and addicted to enjoyments along with you.

sa: शाखासु सप्तच्छदपादपानां प्रभासु तारार्कनिशाकराणाम्। लीलासु चैवोत्तमवारणानां श्रियं विभज्याद्य शरत्प्रवृत्ता॥
en: Forsooth has the autumn set in, dividing its grace in the branches of Saptacada trees, in the rays of the Sun and Moon with stars and in the gaits of the excellent elephants.

sa: शीलवृद्धैर्ज्ञानवृद्धैर्वयोवृद्धैश्च सज्जनैः। कथयन्नास्त वै नित्यमस्त्रयोग्यान्तरेष्वपि ॥
en: In the intervals of martial exercises, he always discoursed with persons of character, or wise men, or the aged, or the virtuous.

sa: अद्य बार्हस्पतः श्रीमान् युक्तः पुष्येण राघव। प्रोच्यते ब्राह्मणैः प्राज्ञैः केन त्वमसि दुर्मनाः॥
en: To day the constellation Puşya is in conjunction with the moon, and planet Bịhaspati is presiding over this conjunction, this day has been declared as the most auspicious one by the learned Brahmins, then why do you cherish such a sorrow in the mind?

sa: एतदेव हि मे रत्नमेतदेव हि मे धनम्। एतदेव हि सर्वस्वमेतदेव हि जीवितम्॥ दर्शश्च पौर्णमासश्च यज्ञाश्चैवाप्तदक्षिणाः। एतदेव हि मे राजन् विविधाश्च क्रियास्तथा॥
en: This is verily my jewel: this is verily my riches: this is verily my all: this is verily my subsistence. And this is my Darsa,* Gifts to Brāhmaṇas on occasions of sacrifice. and this my Paurnamäsa, and this my various sacrifices with dakşiņās; and, O king, this my various rites. *Bi-monthly sacrifice, performed at change of the moon by persons maintaining a perpetual fire. A ceremony performed at the full moon by persons maintaining a perpetual fire.

sa: शनैर्विसृज्यते संध्या नभो नेरिवावृतम्। नक्षत्रतारागहनं ज्योतिर्भिरवभासते॥
en: The noon of night is gradually passing away; and the firmament thick-studded with stars resembling eyes, is illumined up with their light.

sa: मृत्युकालोपमस्याज्ञां राजराजस्य वानराः। सुग्रीवस्याययुः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवभयशङ्किताः॥
en: Hearing the mandate of that king of kings, Sugriva, resembling the Hour of death, the monkeys, conceiving fear for Sugrīva, set out.

sa: स समीपस्थितो राज्ञस्तामवस्थामजज्ञिवान्। वाग्भिः परमतुष्टाभिरभिष्टोतुं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Not knowing the plight that had befallen the king, Sumantra presenting himself before him, endeavoured to gladden the latter with pleasing speech.

sa: ते वसन्तमनुप्राप्तं प्रतिवेद्य परस्परम्। नष्टसंदेशकालार्था निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: And each knowing that spring had appeared, they, the term appointed for their task having run out, dropped down on the ground.

sa: अल्पवीर्यां यदा यक्षी श्रूयते मुनिपुङ्गव। कथं नागसहस्रस्य धारयत्यबला बलम्॥
en: O best of ascetics, I have heard that the Yakşa race is endowed with but small prowess. How can then that one of the weaker sex possess the strength of a thousand elephants?

sa: नातिक्रान्तमिदं लोके पुरुषेणेह केनचित्। तव सभ्रातृभार्यस्य वासः प्राकृतवद् वने॥
en: That Destiny owing to which you will have to pass your days in the forest like a low person, along with your brother and wife, has in this world been withstood by none.

sa: भवान् मे प्रियकामार्थं वचनं यदिहोक्तवान्। अकार्यं कार्यसंकाशमपथ्यं पथ्यसंनिभम् ॥
en: What you, wishing for my welfare, have dwelt upon, though wearing the guise of a good action, is really not such; and though appearing to be beneficent, is really calculated to entail misery.

sa: स मूर्धा न्यपदत् भूमौ प्रलम्बीकृतभूषणः। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतो राघवाय कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Thereupon Sugrīva, exceedingly glad, and delighted with his actions, bowing down his head on the earth and stretching his ornamented person on the ground, addressed with clasped hands, that heroic descendant of Raghu.

sa: दशयोजनविस्तीर्णा त्रिंशद्योजनमायता। छाया वानरसिंहस्य जवे चारुतराभवत्॥
en: The shadow the leonine monkey, measuring ten Yojanas in width and thirty in length, seemed the handsome in consequence of his speed.

sa: ततो नरेन्द्रसंकाशैस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैर्महाबलैः। कृत्स्ना संछादिता भूमिरसंख्येयैः प्लवङ्गमैः॥
en: Then the whole ground was covered with innumerable monkeys gifted with great strength, and having sharp teeth, and resembling kings of men.

sa: पशुरभ्याहृतो राजन् प्रणयस्तव दुर्नयात्। अरक्षितारं राजानं घ्नन्ति दोषा नरेश्वर॥
en: O king, the beast has been stolen (away); and it has been lost through your dereliction. And, O lord of men, his own fault destroy the king that fail to protect (the beast).7

sa: यथान्यः पुरुषः कश्चित् पलाशैर्मोहितो भवेत्। एवं मयाप्यविज्ञातं शब्दवेध्यमिदं फलम्॥
en: Even like another person fascinated by the sight of some Palasa trees (and doing as mentioned above), I (did this act) not fore knowing the consequence that would follow my shooting by sound.

sa: अन्यदा किल धर्मज्ञा सुरभिः सुरसम्मता। वहमानौ ददर्शोर्त्यां पुत्रौ विगतचेतसौ॥
en: Once on a time, it is related by persons cognizant of morality, Surabhi regarded by the celestials, beheld two of her sons toiling on earth and seeming to be deprived of their senses.

sa: स काममनवाप्यैव रामपादावुपस्पृशन्॥ नन्दिग्रामेऽकरोद् राज्यं रामागमनकाङ्क्षया।
en: And then Bharata, finding his desire not fulfilled, touched Rama's feet, and began to rule at Nandigrāma, expecting the return of Rāma.

sa: किं नावबुध्यसे क्रूरे नियतं बन्धुसंश्रयम्। ज्येष्ठं पितृसमं रामं कौसल्यायात्मसम्भवम्॥
en: Does you not, O tortuous one, know that that one sprung from Kucalya's, self, my eldest brother Räma, who is like a father to me, has ever been the refuge of his friends?

sa: बालश्चाकृतबुद्धिश्च एकपुत्रश्च मे प्रियः। तारेयो राम भवता रक्षणीयो महाबलः॥
en: He is my only son, dear and born of Tārā. A mere child and of unripe understanding as he is, that one of mighty strength should always be protected by you, O Rāma.

sa: प्रतिवेदितमाज्ञाय सूतमभ्यन्तरं पितुः। तत्रैवानाययामास राघवः प्रियकाम्यया॥
en: Rāma hearing of the arrival of his father's charioteer, ordered him to enter into the apartment, having his father's pleasure in view.

sa: वधार्थं वयमायातास्तस्य वै मुनिभिः सह ॥ सिद्धगन्धर्वयक्षाश्च ततस्त्वां शरणं गताः। त्वं गतिः परमा देव सर्वेषां नः परंतप ॥
en: It is to compass his death that accompanied by the ascetics, we have come here: it is for this that the Siddhas and the Gandharvas and the Yaksas have taken refuge in you! O God, you are the prime way of us all, O repressor of foes! Do you, for bringing destruction to the enemies of the gods, turn your thoughts to being born as man.

sa: ताः पाणिभिः सुखस्पर्श द्वङ्गुलितलैः शुभैः। प्रममा रजः पृष्ठाद् रामस्यायतलोचनाः॥
en: And those ones furnished with expansive eyes, (on their turn) by means of their fair hands of delicious feed furnished with soft fingers and palms, fell to rubbing the dust off Rāma's back.

sa: तद्रक्षो न भवेदेव वातापिरिव लक्ष्मण। मद्विधं योऽतिमन्येत धर्मनित्यं जितेन्द्रियम्॥
en: Truly that Raksasa, O, Laksmana who wish to surpass one like me who has controlled his senses and is ever engaged in pious offices shall meet with his end like to this Vātāpi.

sa: स त्वं ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु सक्तो मिथ्याप्रतिश्रवः। न त्वां रामो विजानीते सधैं मण्डूकराविणम्॥
en: But, of false promises, you had been indulging in gross enjoyments,-nor does Rāma know you for a serpent, croaking like a frog*. *Crying through the voice of the frog in its mouth. Another meaning is, croaking like a frog, to allure frog to it.

sa: आत्मानुमानात् पश्यामि मग्नस्त्वं शोकसागरे। त्वामहं तारयिष्यामि बाढं प्राप्स्यसि पुष्कलम्॥
en: By what I myself feel, I see that you had sunk in a sea of sorrow. But I will deliver you; and you shall attain both your wife as well as this kingdom.

sa: कृतोदकौ तावपि पक्षिसत्तम स्थिरां च बुद्धिं प्रणिधाय जग्मतुः। प्रवेश्य सीताधिगमे ततो मनो वनं सुरेन्द्राविव विष्णुवासवौ॥
en: Having performed the Udaka ceremony for that best of birds and considering him in the light of a father they went away and entered the forest in quest of Sītā like to the two best of celestials-Visnu and Vasava. glorious work, that king of vultures, consecrated by the ascetic-like Rāma, attained to an excellent state.

sa: नूनं प्राप्ताः स्म सम्भेदं गङ्गायमुनयोर्वयम्। तथाहि श्रूयते शब्दो वारिणोरिघर्षजः॥
en: For certain we have arrived at the confluence of the Gangā and the Yamunā; and it is for this that we hear the roar of the waters produced by the rushing of them.

sa: विद्यासमुदितो रामः शुशुभे भीमविक्रमः॥ सहस्ररश्मिभगवाञ्शरदीव दिवाकरः।
en: And furnished with the sciences, Rāma of dreadful prowess appeared resplendent, even like the adorable autumnal Sun invested with a thousand rays.

sa: स कदाचित् प्रभातायां शर्वर्यां रघुनन्दनः। प्रययावभिषेकार्थं रम्यां गोदावरी नदीम्॥
en: And it came to pass that once on a time, when the night had passed away and day broke, that son of Raghu went to the romantic river Godāvarī for performing his bath.

sa: तीर्णप्रतिज्ञश्च वनात् पुनरेष्याम्यहं पुरीम्। ययातिरिव राजर्षिः पुरा हित्वा पुनर्दिवम्॥
en: Like to the royal saint Yayāti, in the days of yore once falling on earth going again to the abode of celestials, I shall, fulfilling my vows, again return home from the forest.

sa: बाहुभिश्चन्दनादिग्धैः साङ्गदैश्च विशाम्पते। हस्तिहस्तोपमैश्चापि भुजङ्गाभोगसंनिभैः॥ ऊरुभिः पृथिवी च्छन्ना मनुजानां नराधिप। शशाङ्कसंनिभैश्चैव वदनैश्चारुकुण्डलैः॥
en: And O ruler of men, with arms decked with sandal-paste, adorned with Angadas, with human thighs, resembling trunks of elephants or the plump bodies of snakes, the earth became literally covered over. With faces resembling the moon and with heads graced with beautiful ear-rings.

sa: नकुलस्य तथा बाणैर्हन्यमाना चमूस्तव। व्यशीर्यत दिशो राजन् वातनुन्ना इवाम्बुदा॥
en: In the same way, O king, the army on your side, thus slain by the arrows of Nakuſa, dispersed on all sides; even as the masses of clouds are dispersed by the wind.

sa: न मादृशोऽन्यो नरदेव विद्यते धनुर्धरो देवमृते पिनाकिनम्॥ अहं हि तेनानुमतो महात्मना क्षणेन हन्यां सचराचरं जगत्।
en: O ruler of men, excepting only the wielder of Pinaka, the foremost of the Gods, there is no skilled archer like me. On receiving the sanction of that illustrious deity, whose forehead is bedecked with the crescent moon, I can surely destroy in a moment this whole universe with all its organic and inorganic creation.

sa: अथावसन्नः स्वरथे मुहूर्तात् पुनरुत्थितः। स रणे युयुधानेन विसूताश्वरथध्वजः॥ कृतो जिघांसुः शैनेयं खड्गचर्मधृगभ्ययात्।
en: Deprived of his driver, horses, chariot and flags by Yuyudhana, thus struck Vrishasena became senseless on his car but stood up again within the twinkling of an eye. Vrishasena, armed with sword and shield, then rushed against him with a view to kill him.

sa: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय समरे वेगवत्तरम्। नकुलस्य ततो बाणैः सर्वतोऽवारयद् दिशः॥
en: Thereupon in the field of battle he (Karna), taking up another bow, that was possessed of greater strength, closed the different points of the compass, on every side of Nakula, with his arrows.

sa: वीक्ष्य दीप्तमिवायान्तं रिपुविक्षोभकारिणम्। तमुद्यतमहाचापं राक्षसेन्द्र घटोत्कचम्॥
en: Seeing Gatotkacha, the lord of the Rakshasas endued with splendour and capable of striking terror into foes, advance upraising his great bow.

sa: तत्रावधीन्महाबाहुः सैन्धवं दूरवासिनम्। अवश्यं तु मया कार्य: सूतपुत्रस्य निग्रहः॥
en: The mighty armed Dhananjaya slew the king of the Sindhus, who indeed, was the remote cause of the slaughter of Abhimanyu. It is surely my imperative duty to crush the son of Suta.

sa: उपलभ्य रणे क्रीडेद् यथा शकुनिना शिशुः। यदि काष्णिर्धनुष्पाणिरिह स्यान्मकरध्वजः॥
en: Obtaining you in battle, will sport with you as boy with an innocent bird. If that son of Krishna bearing the Makara as a device on his banner, were here with his bow.

sa: श्रुत्वा चैतद् वचश्चित्रं हेतुकार्यार्थसंहितम्। कुरु शल्य विनिश्चित्य माभूदत्र विचारणा॥
en: O Shalya, having listened to that beautiful story, which is full of causes and consequences of actions and also having settled all, do this immediately. There should be made no doubt about this.

sa: दुर्योधनं च बाणाभ्यां तीक्ष्णाभ्यां विरथीकृतम्। आविध्यद्धस्ततलयोरुभ्योरर्जुनस्तदा॥
en: Thereafter Arjuna pierced with two sharp arrows, the two palms of Duryodhana who had been deprived of the use of his car.

sa: ततः किरीटी परवीरघाती हताश्वमालोक्य नरप्रवीरः। णाद्रीसुतं नकुलं लोकमध्ये समीक्ष्य कृष्णं भृशविक्षतं च॥
en: Arjuna, the great warrior of this human world, capable to kill all enemies a attacked forcibly on Vrishasena who had killed the horses of Nakula, the son of Madri and made attack on injured Sri Krishna Vrishasena was stood before Karna at that time.

sa: अश्वत्थाम्न स चिक्षेप भैमसेनिर्जिघांसया। वेगेन महताऽऽगच्छद् विक्षिप्तं द्रौणिना शरैः॥
en: Was hurled by the son of Bhimasena at Ashvatthama with the desire of slaying (him). cut-off into fragments by the son of Drona with arrows as it coursed with great speed (towards him).

sa: समुद्रतरणं दो• कण्ठे बद्ध्वा यथा शिलाम्। गिर्यग्राद् वा निपतनं ताद्दक् तव चिर्कीर्षितम्॥
en: This your attempt is like that of a person, who, having tied round his neck a heavy stone, wishes to cross the ocean with his two arms or like that of a man who wishes to leap down from the summit of a mountain.

sa: यत्तत् पृथां वागुवाचान्तरिक्षे सप्ताहजाते त्वयि मन्दबुद्धे। जातः पुत्रो वासवविक्रमोऽयं सर्वाशूराशात्रवाञ्जेष्यतीति॥ अयं जेता खाण्डवे देवसंघान् सर्वाणि भूयान्यपि चोत्तमौजाः। नयं कुरूपन् राजमध्ये निहत्या॥
en: O you of wicked sense, an invisible voice from the sky said to Pritha, on the seventh day from your birth; ‘This son born to you will be powerful like Vasava. He will vanquish all his powerful enemies. Gifted with a superior energy he will defeat at Khandava all the gods assisted by other creatures. He ill conquer the Madra, the Kalingas and the Kaikeyas. He will kill the Kurus in the midst of numbers of kings.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे द्रौणिरभ्ययात् सुमहाबलम्। पार्षतं शत्रुदमनं शत्रुवीर्यसुनाशनम्॥
en: In the meantime the highly powerful son of Drona approached Parshata, the subduer of his enemies and the destroyer of their prowess.

sa: यदेको राक्षसी सेनां क्षणाद् द्रौणिर्महास्रवित्। ददाह ज्वलितैर्बाणै राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: In as much as single-handed the son of Drona, versed in great weapons, by means of blazing darts, burnt that Rakshasa ariny in a moment in the very presence of the Rakshasa king.

sa: चेष्टन्तो विविधाचेष्टा व्यदृश्यन्त महाहवे। वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे घोरे देवासुरोपमे॥
en: Were seen to roll in various movements on the ground in that great battle. During the progress of that terrible battle resembling that between the Gods and the Asuras in days of yore.

sa: निरुद्ध तत्र मार्गे च शरसंधैः समन्ततः। व्यरोचेतां महात्मानौ कालसूर्याविवोदितौ॥
en: While all the directions were thus closed with the shots of innumerable arrows from all sides, those two lofty-minded heroes blazed forth like two risen suns appearing at the time of universals dissolution,

sa: चिकीर्षुस्तव पुत्राणां प्रियं प्राणभृतां वरः॥ ततोऽब्रवीत् सकैकेयान् पञ्चालान् गौतमीसुतः।
en: (And) that foremost of those that bear life was desirous of doing what was agreeable to your sons. Then the son of Goutama's daughter said thus to the Panchalas together with the Kaikeyas.

sa: खङ्गजिआँ धनुरास्यं शरदंष्ट्रं तरस्विनम्। दृप्तं पुरुषशार्दूलं जहि कर्ण धनंजय॥
en: O Dhananjaya, do slay that mighty Karna, who has the sword for his tongue, the bow for his mouth, the arrows for his teeth and who is moreover arrogant and energetic. Slaughter him.

sa: क्रोधरक्तेक्षणौ तौ तु क्रोधात् प्रस्फुरिताधरौ। क्रोधात् संदष्टदशनौ तथैव दशनच्छदौ॥
en: Due to angry those two heroic eyes became red. They had their lips quivering with wrath. Out of wrath, again, they grinded their teeth and in the same way their lips as well.

sa: त्यजायुधममोघेषो तिष्ठ वर्त्मनि शाश्वते। परिपूर्णश्च कालस्ते वस्तुं लोकेऽद्य मानुषे॥
en: Lay aside your weapons, shake off the pale of error that hangs over you and betake yourself to the eternal path (of virtue). Today, the days of your earthly habitation have been numbered.

sa: अष्टचक्रसमायुक्तमास्थाय विपुलं रथम्। शूलमुद्गरधारिण्या शैलपादपहस्तया।॥ रक्षसां घोररूपाणामक्षौहिण्या समावृतः। तमुद्यतमहाचापं निशम्य व्यथिता नृपाः॥
en: And with eight wheels. (And he) sat down on this car surrounding by one Akshauhini of terrible-looking Rakshasa armed with maces and clubs and carrying rocks an trees in their hands. The kings were (greatly) pained on seeing him (to advance) with upraised bow.

sa: ततः प्रतिकृते यत्नं कुर्वाणौ तौ महारणे। कृतप्रतिकृते यत्तौ शरसङ्घरभीतवत्॥
en: Thereupon, in that dreadful battle, those two heroic warriors made their best attempts in counteracting each other's deeds; and with the torrents of shafts they most fearlessly made efforts in challenging each other.

sa: अजातशत्रु कौन्तेयं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्। मदाणामीश्वरः शल्योराजाराजानमावृणोत्॥
en: King Shalya the ruler of the Madras began to resist king Ajatsatru Yudhishthira that son of Kunti, who resembled a blazing fire.

sa: गदानिपातसंह्रादैर्भुवं कम्पयतोम॑शम्। गदाविमुक्तौ तौ भूयः समासाद्येतरेतरम्॥
en: Causing the earth to tremble repeatedly with the fall of their maces. Then again throwing aside their maces and bearing each other.

sa: हत्वा युधिष्ठिरानीकं पञ्चालानां रथव्रजान्। प्रताप्य शरवर्षेण दिश: सर्वा महारथः॥
en: Having slain the entire force of Yudhishthira as well as the car-warriors of the Panchala race and having afflicted, by the showers of arrows, the men in the different directions of the horizon.

sa: सात्यके त्वं च गच्छस्व वृष्ण्यन्धकवृतो गृहान्॥
en: “Fly, O you Dhristadyumna, taking with you all the Panchala divisions; you also, Satyaki, go away with all Vrishnis and the Andhkas.

sa: तं तु कृच्छ्रगतं दृष्ट्वा कर्णद्रौणिकृपादयः॥ अभ्यवर्तन्त सहसा परीप्सन्तो नराधिपम्।
en: After beholding him thus fallen into imminent danger, Karna, the son of Drona, Kripa and other heroes all on a sudden proceeded towards him with the desire of saving that ruler of men.

sa: सात्यकिर्नवभिश्चैनमवधीत् कुरुपुङ्गवम्। सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता समरे दृढधन्विना॥
en: Satyaki too pierced that foremost of Kurus with nine shafts. Deeply wounded in battle by that powerful and firm wielder of bow.

sa: न हि धर्मविभागज्ञः कुर्यादेवं धनंजय। यथा त्वं पाण्डवाद्येह धर्मभीरुरपण्डितः॥
en: O Dhananjaya, those who are versed in the niceties of religion would never act in the way as you are doing today, O pious son of Pandu, on not being acquainted with them.

sa: देवदानवगन्धर्वा नागयक्षाः पतत्रिणः॥ महर्षयो वेदविदः पितरश्च स्वधाभुजः। तपोविद्यास्तथौषध्यो नानारूपबलान्विताः॥ अन्तरिक्षे महाराज विनदन्तोऽवतस्थिरे।
en: O monarch, the Gods, Danavas Yakshas, Nagas, the birds, the learned Rishis well versed in the Vedas, the Pitris who live upon Swadha, the Sciences and asceticism and herbs of heavenly qualities all came and with great noise took their position in the sky.

sa: दन्तैर्दशन्तो वसुधां शेरते क्षतजोक्षिताः। भग्नमूर्धास्थिचरणा: क्रव्यादगणभोजनाः॥
en: Covered with blood, with heads, bones and legs broken, they biting the earth i.e. (eating dust) became food for animals gf prey.

sa: धनं धनेश्वरस्येव हृत्वा पार्थस्य मे सुतः। मधुप्रेप्सुरिवाबुद्धिः प्रपातं नावबुध्यते॥
en: Having robbed Yudhishthira the son of Pritha's who is like the Lord of wealth, of his wealth, my foolish son sees not the impending fall, like a searcher of honey (on the mountains).

sa: धनुश्च तत् केशवाय प्रयच्छ यन्ता भविष्यस्त्वं रणे केशवस्य॥ तदाहनिष्यत् केशवः कर्णमुग्रं मरुत्पतिवृत्रमिवात्तवज्रः।
en: If you, O wretch, had even made over your bow to Kesava and contented yourself by being his charioteer, he would have slain that fearful Karna, as the lords of the Maruts (Shakra) slew with thunder the Asura known by the name of Vritra.

sa: अथ चन्द्रपभां मुष्णन्नादित्यस्य पुरःसरः। अरुणोऽभ्युदयांचक्रे ताम्रीकुर्वन्निवाम्बरम्॥
en: Soon after Arjuna (the sun's charioteer) robbing the effulgence of the moon, appeared on the sky, spreading a coppery hue over it.

sa: निशीथे राजशार्दूल स्तनयित्नोरिवाम्बरे। हाहाकाररवांश्चैव सिंहनादांश्च पुष्कलान्॥
en: Hark, O foremost of monarchs, the roar of drums near Arjuna's chariot, resembling the rumble of clouds at the dead of night.

sa: वृतः सहस्रैर्दशभिर्गजानामनिवर्तिनाम्। रथैश्च दशसाहस्रेस्तूर्णं याहि धनंजयम्॥
en: "Supported by a host of ten thousand unretreating elephants and also by detachment of ten thousand car-warriors, do you proceed against Dhananjaya.

sa: यथाश्वहृदयं वेद वासुदेवो महामनाः। द्विगुणं त्वं तथा वेत्सि मद्रराजेश्वरात्मज॥
en: As that high-souled Vasudeva is thoroughly versed in the knowledge about horses, even so you, O royal chief of the Madras, is twice acquainted with that knowledge. There is no doubt about it.

sa: दिदक्षवश्चाप्रतिमं द्वैरथं नरसिंहयोः। देवदानवगन्धर्वाः सर्व एवावतस्थिरे॥
en: And actually all the Gods, Danavas and Gandharvas waited anxiously to see that unrivaled duel between those two men of leonine prowess.

sa: स शब्दः पृथिवी कृत्स्नां पूरयामास सर्वशः॥ शोकार्णवे महाघोरे निमग्ना भरतस्त्रियः। रुरुदुर्दुःखशोकार्ता भृशमुद्विग्नचेतसः॥
en: Which (the noise) filled the entire earth to all its points. The ladies of the house hold of Bharata, greatly burnt in grief and with hearts filled with great anxiety, bewailed most bitterly, plunged as they were in the very deep ocean of sorrow.

sa: तत्राकरोन्महाराज कदनं सूतनन्दनः। मध्यं प्राप्ते दिनकरे चक्रवद् विचरन् प्रभुः॥
en: O most powerful monarch, that lord the son of Suta, circling round the field of battle, like a wheel, perpetuated an immense slaughter there at the time when the sun attained the meridian.

sa: सैन्धवे सक्तदृष्टित्वान्नैनं पश्यामि माधवम्। एतत् त्वसुकरं कर्म यादवार्थे करोम्यहम्॥
en: “O Madhava, my eyes being fixed on the ruler of the Sindhus, I cannot see Bhurisravas; but for the sake of that descendant of Yadu's, race, I shall perform a very difficult feat.”

sa: ते समेत्य रणे राजज्छस्रप्रासासिधारिणः। परस्परमुदैक्षन्त परस्परकृतागसः॥
en: Taking up their lances, swords and (other) weapons and encountering one another, they looked wrathfully at one another in battle, o king.

sa: प्रदीपानां सहस्रैश्च दीप्यमानैः समन्ततः। रत्नाचितैः स्वर्णदण्डैर्गन्धतैलावसिञ्चितैः॥
en: With thousands of lamps shedding their lustre all around and placed upon golden steeds adorned with gems and fed with fragrant oil.

sa: तबले पाण्डवानां च सहस्त्राणि शतानि च॥
en: "Come, strike, rush quickly; the two heroes, scion of Madhu's race and the son of Pandu, have entered into the Kuru army.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धौ महाराज बाणौ गृह्य महाहवे। उभौ चिक्षिपतुस्तूर्णमन्योन्यस्य वधैषिणौ।॥
en: Thereupon, O powerful monarch, those two wrathful warriors, most desirous of slaying cach other, after having taken up two arrows, hurled at each other those shafts without any hesitation, in that dreadful encounter.

sa: प्रकीर्णकेशा विध्वस्ता न द्वावेकर धावतः। नेदमस्तीति मन्वाना हतोत्साहा हतौजसः॥
en: Their hair dishevelled and their accouterments falling off, no two persons were seen to fly together; their courage gone and their splendour destroyed, men then thought that the Kuru army was completely annihilated.

sa: प्रतिज्ञाय ततो देवो देवतानां रिपुक्षयम्। रामं भार्गवमाहूय सोऽभ्यभाषत् शङ्करः॥
en: Thereupon that god Shankara, after having promised all the celestials the destruction of their enemies and also having called Rama, that descendent of Bhrigu's race before him, addressed him in the following language.

sa: दविस्थितं प्रमुख पाण्डवं तम्। वृकोदरं कालमिवात्तदण्डं गदाहस्तं योधयन्तं त्वदीयान्॥
en: Then Vrisasena, all wrathful, with his car advanced against that son of Pandu viz. Vrikodara who was destroying your arıny and with his mace was looking like Pluto himself with his death-dealing sceptre.

sa: विशेषयन् सूतपुत्रं भीमस्तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्। पुनश्चासृजदुग्राणि शरवर्षाणि पाण्डवः॥ अमर्षी बलवान् क्रुद्धो दिधक्षन्निव पावकः। ततश्चटचटाशब्दो गोधाघातादभूत् तयोः॥
en: And then obtaining some advantage over the son of Suta, he cried out saying wait, wait, then the irate and powerful son of Pandu, like an all-destroying fire once more shot excitedly showers of arrows. Then a loud sound was produced there, in consequence of the leathern gloves of the combatants striking against their bow-strings.

sa: येऽन्यायेन निहीर्षन्तो धर्ममिच्छन्ति कर्हिचित्। अकूजनेन मोक्षं वा नानुकूजेत् कथंचन॥
en: Those who try to stick to them logically, have scarcely a mind to acquire morality. If you can get rid of them without a word do no account have any intercourse with them.

sa: अथाययबाणैर्दशबिर्धनंजयं पराभिनद् द्रोणसुतोऽच्युतं त्रिभिः। चतुर्भिरश्वांश्चतुरः कपि ततः शरैश्च नारावरैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Drona's son (Ashvatthama) coming forward shot ten choicest arrows against Dhananjaya, three against Krishna, four against the four horses and many other good arrows against the great ape in charge of his standard.

sa: उत्कृत्तवदनैर्दैहैः शरीरैः कृत्तबाहुभिः। भुजैश्च पाणिनिर्मुक्तैः पाणिभिर्व्यङ्गुलीकृतैः॥
en: Strewn over with mangled faces and bodies and limbs, with lacerated arms, with arms deprived of palms and palms deprived of fingers.

sa: तथा तमिस्रहा देवो मयूखैर्भावयञ्जगत्। मार्गमेतदसम्बाधमादित्यः परिवर्तते॥
en: In a similar way, the god Aditya, the dispeller of darkness displaying the universe by his rays, moves round this unobstructed path.

sa: ततः स भगवानाग्निश्चकमे तां सुदर्शनाम्। नीलस्य राज्ञः सर्वेषामुपनीतश्च सोऽभवत्॥
en: It was said in the king Nila's palace and in the houses of all (men) that the illustrious Agni wanted to marry that beautiful maiden; and he was (in fact) accepted by her.

sa: स्वस्तिवचनमासीत् पुष्परथस्य प्रयोजनेन तमहमन्वगच्छं स्वस्तिवाचितेषु ब्राह्मणेषु रथो ब्राह्मणानां दर्शितः॥
en: He was engaged in the ceremony of Svastivachana for a flowery car, and at that time I came there. When the Brahmanas finished the Svastivachana ceremony, then the car became visible to them.

sa: यस्तु नित्यं कृतमतिर्धर्ममेवाभिपद्यते। अशङ्कमानः कल्याणि सोऽमुत्रानन्त्यमश्नुते॥
en: O blessed lady, he however, who, with faith and without any doubt follows religion, attains to eternal bliss in the next world.

sa: एतावदेव पर्याप्तमुपमानं शुचिस्मिते। कर्मणां फलमाप्नोतिधीरोऽल्पेनापि तुष्यति॥
en: These are sufficient proofs, O you of sweet smiles; the self-controlled reap the fruits of acts and are satisfied with a little.

sa: ततस्तानि शरीराणि गतसत्त्वानि रक्षसाम्। अपाकृष्यन्त शैलाचाद्धनाधिपतिशासनात्॥
en: Then the dead bodies of the Rakshasas were removed from the summit of the mountain by order of the lord of wealth.

sa: न चाम्यधर्मेषु रतिस्तवास्ति कामान किंचित् कुरुषे नरेन्द्र। न चार्थलोभात् प्रजहासिधर्म तस्मात् प्रभावादसिधर्मराजः॥
en: You are are neither addicted to sensual pleasures, nor, O king of kings, do you perform anything froin motives of self-interest nor do you subserve your duties to greed of wealth. It is (for these reasons) that you have been styled the virtuous King.

sa: स्थानमेतन्महाभागध्रुवमक्षयमव्ययम्। ईश्वरस्य सदा ह्येतत् प्रणमात्र युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O highly fortunate Yudhishthira, this place is eternal, without deterioration or end; because it is always the very life of that god.

sa: युधिष्ठिरोऽपिधर्मात्मा तमेवार्थं विचिन्तयन्। तीर्थयात्राश्रितं पुण्यमृषीणां प्रत्यवेदयत्॥
en: And the virtuous-minded Yudhishthira also, reflecting on the subject, recited before the Rishis the merits that are derived from visiting the Tirthas.

sa: कृष्णाल्ललामांश्चमराज्छुक्लांश्चान्याञ्छशिप्रभान्। हिमवत्पुष्पजं चैव स्वादु क्षौद्रं तथा बहु॥ उत्तरेभ्यः कुरुभ्यश्चाप्यपोढं माल्यमम्बुभिः। उत्तरादपि कैलासादोषधीः सुमहाबलाः॥ पर्वतीया बलिं चान्यमाहृत्य प्रणताः स्थिताः। अजातशत्रोपतेरि तिष्ठन्ति वारिताः॥
en: The powerful mountain tribes, having brought as tribute many soft and black Chamaras and many others as white as the moon-beam, and also sweet honey extracted from the flowers growing on the Himalayas and also from the Mechelia champaka, and also garlands of flowers brought from the land of the northern Kurus, and also various kinds of plants from the north, even from the Kailasa (mountain), waited at the gate with their heads down, being refused admittance.

sa: वपायां हूयमानायांधूममाघ्राय मातरः। ततस्ताः सुमहावीर्याञ्जनयिष्यन्ति ते सुतान्।॥ तस्यामेव तु ते जन्तुर्भविता पुनरात्मजः। उत्तरे चास्य सौवर्णं लक्ष्म पार्श्वे भविष्यति॥
en: When Jantu's fat will be put into the fire as an offering to the celestials, the mothers your wives will have to take a smell of that smoke. ! And thus they would give birth to a number of courageous and strong sons. Jantu also will again be born in the womb of his (former) mother. On this back there will appear a mark of gold.

sa: ततस्तत्रैवासीने राजनि सेनान्वगच्छत्॥
en: When he was thus living, his soldiers arrived at that spot.

sa: चातुर्मास्येषु यस्येष्टमश्वमेधेऽचजः प्रभुः। दीप्तो ज्वालैरनेकाभैरग्निरेकोऽथ वीर्यवान्॥
en: At the Chaturmasya and the Ashvamedha sacrifices, animals are first offered in his honour; this powerful fire is indicated by numerous flames.

sa: तस्य मूर्ध्नि शितं खङ्गमसक्तं पर्वतेष्वपि। मुमोच भुजवीर्येण विक्रम्य कुरुनन्दनः॥
en: Then that prince of the Kuru race struck that sharp weapon in his (Kirata's) head with the whole strength of his arms, a weapon which could not be resisted even by solid rocks.

sa: वचनाद् देवराजस्य ततोऽस्मीहागतो द्रुतम्॥ अयं दुरात्मा बद्धश्च गमिष्यामि सुरालयम्। नेष्याम्येनं दुरात्मानं पाकशासनशासनात्॥
en: At these words of the lord of the celestials, I speedily came here. The wicked wretch is now in chains, I shall go to the abode of the celestials. I shall now take this wicked-minded one at the command of the slayer of Paka.

sa: दिष्टया वर्धसि धर्मज्ञ साम्राज्यं प्राप्तवानसि। आजमीढाजमीढानां यशः संवर्धितं त्वया॥
en: "O virtuous man, you have grown in prosperity by good fortune. You have acquired the imperial dignity. The fame of the Ajamida race has been greatly increased by (you) the descendant of Ajamida.

sa: पर्वतैश्छाद्यमानोऽहं निगृहीतैश्च वाजिभिः। अगच्छं परमामार्तं मातलिस्तदलक्षयत्॥
en: That I was sore afflicted on account of being surrounded by rocks and the steeds being hard pressed, was perceived by Matali.

sa: कृष्ण कृष्ण महायोगिन् विश्वात्मन् विश्वभावन। प्रपन्नां पाहि गोविन्द कुरुमध्येऽवसीदतीम्॥
en: O Krishna, O great Yogi, O soul of the universe, O creator of the world, O Govinda, save me who am distressed, who am losing her senses in the midst of the Kurus!

sa: दृष्टीविषैः सप्तशीर्षैर्गुप्तं भोगिभिरद्भुतैः। रक्षोभिश्च पिशाचैश्च रौद्रैर्भूतगणैस्तथा॥ राक्षसीभिश्च सम्पूर्णमनेकैश्च मृगद्विजैः।
en: That mountain guarded by seven headed serpents with poison in their very looks and frequented by the male and famale, Rakshashas, the Pishachas, the fearful spirits and various kinds of birds and beasts.

sa: सर्वकामगुणोपेतं वीतशोकमनामयम्। ब्रह्मणा भरतश्रेष्ठ कालकेयकृते कृतम्॥
en: Containing all the desirable objects and devoid of grief and desire. O best of the Bharatas, created by Brahma for the Kalakeyas,

sa: सूतस्तस्य नरेन्द्रस्य विरूपो ह्रस्वबाहुकः। शीघ्रयानेषु कुशलो मृष्टकर्ता च भोजने॥
en: That Bahuka is the charioteer of that foremost of monarchs. He is also possessed of extraordinary appearance and short arms; and is skilled in driving with speed and also in cooking sweet food.

sa: विक्षतं चायसैर्बाणैर्मत्प्रयुक्तैरजिह्मगैः। महीमभ्यपतद् राजन् प्रभग्नं पुरमासुरम्॥
en: (And), O king, that city of the Asuras, riven and broken by straight-coursing steels darts shot by me, fell to the ground.

sa: वृद्धः किल समुद्रान्ते कश्चिद्वंसोऽभवत् पुरा। धर्मवागन्यथावृत्तः पक्षिणः सोऽनुशास्ति च॥
en: In the days of yore there lived an old swan on the coast of the sea. He always spoke of morality and used to instruct all the birds, but his conduct was otherwise.

sa: ददृशुर्विविधाश्चर्यं कैलास पर्वतोत्तमम्। तस्याभ्याशे तु ददृशुर्नरनारायणाश्रमम्॥
en: They then saw that best of mountains, the Kailasa, full of wonderful sights. They then saw the hermitage of Nara and Narayana.

sa: जलोदरसमायुक्ताः श्चित्रिणः पलितास्तथा। अपुमांसः कृताः स्त्रीभिर्जडान्धबधिरास्तथा॥
en: Women have sometimes caused dropsy and leprosy, decrepitude, impotency and idiocy, blindness and deafness in men (by administering drugs to enchant them).

sa: प्रणयं प्रतिसंहृत्य निधायात्मानमात्मनि। शुश्रुषुनिरहंमाना पतीनां चित्तरक्षिणी॥
en: Restraining jealously with devotion of heart and without any feeling of degradation at the service I perform, I always serve my husbands.

sa: नैतामतिशये जातु वस्त्रभूषणभोजनैः। नापि परिवदे चाहं तां पृथां पृथिवीरामाम्॥
en: I never show any preference for myself over her in matters of food and attire and ornaments. I never reprove in words Pritha (Kuni) who is equal to the earth herself in forgiveness.

sa: दुमाणां वातभग्नानां पततां भूतलेऽनिशम्। अन्येषां च महीजानां शब्दः समभवन्महान्॥
en: There arose great sounds proceeding from the trees and also from those trees that continually broke down blown up by the wind and also from those trees that fell down on the ground.

sa: एते द्रोणादयश्चैव वृद्धा धर्मविदो जनाः। शून्यैः शरीरैस्तिष्ठन्ति गतासव इवानताः॥
en: These men of mature years, learned in the precepts of morality, (namely) Drona and others, sit with down cast heads like men who are dead and whose lives have departed from their bodies.

sa: नैवविंग् नैव चाचार्यो न राजा मधुसूदनः। अर्चितश्च कुरुश्रेष्ठ किमन्यत्प्रियकाम्यया॥
en: O best of the Kuru race, the slayer of Madhu (Krishna) is neither a sacrificial priest, nor a preceptor, nor a king, why have you worshipped Krishna with the motive of pleasing others?

sa: तस्मिन् धर्मविदां श्रेष्ठो धर्मराजस्य धीमतः। महाध्वरे महाबुद्धिस्तस्थौ स बहुमानतः॥
en: That foremost of all men, learned in the precepts of virtue, that greatly intelligent man (Narada), (thinking of all this), sat in the sacrifice of the intelligent Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) with feelings of awe.

sa: इदममरवरात्मजस्य घोरं शुचि चरितं विनिशम्य फाल्गुनस्य। स्त्रिदिवगता विरमन्ति मानवेन्द्राः॥
en: Those foremost of men, who listen to this history of greatly pure conduct of Falgunii (Arjuna), becoming freed from pride, arrogance, wrath an other faults, ascend to heaven and they (merrily) sport there.

sa: युधिष्ठिरमुपागम्य पूजयामास संजयः। भीमार्जुनयमाश्चापि तद्युक्तं प्रतिपेदिरे॥
en: Coming to Yudhishthira, Sanjaya duly worshipped him. He was received with due respect by Bhima, Arjuna and the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva).

sa: पतता हि विमानायान्मया शक्रासनाद् द्रुतम्। कुरु शापान्तमित्युक्तो भगवान् मुनिसत्तमः॥
en: When I was rapidly falling (down on earth) from the throne of Shakra, placed in front of the palace, I besought the divine and excellent sage (Agastya) to free me from the curse.

sa: लोहान् परमकाम्बोजानृषिकानुत्तरानपि। सहितांस्तान् महाराज व्यजयत् पाकशासनिः॥
en: O great king, the son of Indra also subjugated the allied tribes of the Lokas, the eastern Kambojas and the northern Rishikas.

sa: राजज्छीलनिधिः स्फीतो दमयन्त्या सुरक्षितः साक्षिणो रक्षिणश्चास्या वयं त्रीन् परिवत्सरान्॥
en: O monarch, protected by Damayanti, the honour of your family, even as the wealth, has much increased. We bear testimony to this, as we have been her protectors for the last three years.

sa: करभाणां सहस्राणि कोशं तस्य महात्मनः। ऊहुर्दश महाराज कृच्छ्रादिव महाधनम्॥
en: That best of the Kuru race, Nakula of great resources, then returned (to Indraprastha). So great was the treasure that he brought that ten thousand camels carried the treasure of that illustrious prince.

sa: सोमक उवाच धिगस्त्विहैकपुत्रत्वमपुत्रत्वं वरं भवेत्। नित्यातुरत्वाद् भूतानां शोक एवैकपुत्रता॥
en: Somaka said: Fie on having one son! I would rather be a sonless man. To all beings, liable as they are to diseases, it is but a trouble to have only one son.

sa: प्राची राजा दक्षिणां भीमसेनो यमौ प्रतीचीमथ वाप्युदीचीम्। धनुर्धराणां सहितो मृगाणां क्षयं चक्रुर्नित्यमेवोपगम्य॥
en: The king going towards the east and Bhima towards the south and the twins towards the west or the north, put an end to the race of the deer in the forest (by daily killing them with their bows) for the sake of meat.

sa: त्वामृते न हि लोकेऽन्य एकाह्ना पृथिवीपते। समर्थो योजनशतं गन्तुमश्चैवर्नराधिप॥
en: O ruler of the earth, O'foremost of the kings, there is none else in this world, who is able to journey, with the help of steeds, a hundred yojanas in a single day.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पाण्डवास्तु वने वासमुद्दिश्य भरतर्षभाः। प्रययुर्जाह्नवीकूलात् कुरुक्षेत्रं सहानुगाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Being desirous of living in the forest, the foremost men of the Bharata race, the sons of Pandu with their followers to the banks of the Ganges to the Kurukshetra.

sa: न मेऽद्य वक्ष्यस्यतिवादिमानिन् ग्लहं प्रपन्नः सरितामिवागमः। हुताशनस्येव समिद्धतेजसः स्थिरो भवस्वेह ममाद्य बन्दिन्॥
en: O Bandi, you consider that you are the foremost of all controversialists. When you will engage with me to argue, you will then not be able to flow like the current of a river. I am like a flaming fire. Be silent before me.

sa: यदि मां मेघनिर्घोषो नोपगच्छति नैषधः। अद्य चामीकरप्रख्यं प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्॥
en: If the king of the Nishadhas do not come to me with his voice as deep as the rumbling of the cloud, today I will surely enter into the fire of golden brilliance.

sa: एष वै सर्वकल्याणः समाधिस्तव भारत। नैनं शत्रुर्विषहते शक्रेणापि समोऽप्युत॥
en: O descendent of Bharata, for this patient abstraction from the worldly possessions will be great benefit to you. No enemy, even if he be like Shakra (Indra), will be able to stand it.

sa: अभिदुद्राव तं हन्तुं गरुत्मानिव पन्नगम्। सोऽन्तरिक्षमवप्लुत्य विधूय सहसा गदाम्॥ प्रविक्षेप महाबाहुर्विनद्य रणमूर्धनि। सेन्द्राशनिरिवेन्द्रेण विसृष्टा वातरंहसा॥
en: Rushed to kill Maniman, as Garuda (does) to kill the serpent. And then he (Bhima) of mighty arms advancing ahead in the field, suddenly jumped in the air and whirling his mace, hurled (at Maniman) uttering yells. And like the thunderbolt hurled by Indra, that (mace) like a pest, with the speed of the wind,

sa: इत्युक्तः पुनरेवाथ तं दाशः प्रत्यभाषत। चिकीर्षुर्दुष्करं कर्म राज्यार्थे भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, having been thus addressed (by Bhishma), the chief of the fishermen, desirous of achieving the difficult matter of making his daughter's son king, thus spoke to him.

sa: भानुमन्तं महाघोषं सर्वरत्नमनोरमम्। ससर्ज यं सुतपसा भौमनो भुवनप्रभुः॥ प्रजापतिरनिर्देश्यं यस्य रूपं रवेरिव। यं स्म सोमः समारुह्य दानवानजयत् प्रभुः॥
en: Its splendour was very great and the sound of its wheels were tremendous; it delighted the heart of every creature that looked at it. It was created by Prajapati after severe ascetic mediation. It was as effulgent as the sun and its splendour was so great that none could gaze at it. It was that very chariot riding on which the lord Soma defeated the Danavas.

sa: शृण्वञ्च्छ्राद्धः पुण्यशीलः श्रावयंश्चेदमद्भुतम्। नरः फलमवाप्नोति राजसूयाश्वमेधयोः॥
en: The virtuous man, who hears or causes it to be heard with reverence, obtains the fruits of a Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sa: आशीभिर्वर्धयित्वा च तमुवाचास्यतामिति। निषसादाभ्यनुज्ञातस्ततो राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Uttering benedictions on him, he (the Rishi) asked him (Yudhishthira) to take his seat. Thus commanded, the king Yudhishthira took his seat.

sa: रममाणस्तया साधं यथाकामं नरेश्चरः। अष्टावजनयत् पुत्रांस्तम्यापमरसंनिभान्॥
en: When the king was thus enjoying himself with his wife, eight sons were born to him. They were all like the celestial.

sa: प्रतिगृह्णीष्व काकुत्स्थ मत्प्रियं कुरु राघव। दत्तस्य हि पुनर्दाने सुमहत्फलमुच्यते॥
en: By accepting this, O Kākutstha, do you satisfy my desire. It is said, that one attains to best fruits if he makes present to his deity, of best articles he gets from another.

sa: क्षिप्रमन्तर्दधे शौरिश्चक्षुषां प्रियदर्शनः। अकामा एव पार्थास्ते गोविन्दगतमानसाः॥ निवृत्योपययुस्तूर्णं स्वं पुरं पुरुषर्षभा। स्यन्दनेनाथ कृष्णोऽपि त्वरितं द्वारकामगात्॥
en: The handsome hero (Krishna) disappeared from their view. The sons of Pritha, those best of men with their minds fixed on Govinda (Krishna) desisted (from following him); and they then soon returned to their own city, although they were not (at all) willing (to return). Riding on his car Krishna also soon started for Dwarka.

sa: समृद्धैश्चाश्वमेधैश्च इष्ट्वा परमदुर्जयः॥ राजवंशांश्च बहुशो बहून्संस्थापयिष्यति।
en: None shall be able to vanquish him. He shall celebrate many a horse-sacrifice with profuse gifts and shall establish many royal families.

sa: त्वमिन्द्रस्त्वं हयमुखस्त्वं शर्वस्त्वं जगत्पतिः। त्वं मुखं पद्मजो विप्रस्त्वमग्निः पवनस्तथा।॥
en: You are Indra, you are steed-necked Vishnu, you are Shiva, You are the Lord of the universe, you are the principal, you are Brahma and Brahmanas, you are Agni, you are the wind.

sa: विजयाय प्रयास्यामि दिशं धनदपालिताम्। तिथावथ मुहूर्ते च नक्षत्रे चाभिपूजिते॥
en: I shall start, in an auspicious moment of a holy day of the moon under a favourable constellation, to conquer the kingdoms situated in the quarter protected by the lord of wealth (Kubera).

sa: यजतो दीर्घसत्रैर्मे शापाचोशनसो मुनेः। कामार्थः परिहीणोऽयं तप्येयं तेन पुत्रकाः॥
en: During a long sacrifice, I was cursed by the Rishi Ushanas and therefore, thus have I lost all my powers of enjoying sensual pleasures. O sons, I shall enjoy myself with your youth.

sa: ज्ञातित्राणमभीप्सद्भिरस्मत्सम्भावना कृता। दत्त्वाक्रूराय सुतनुं तामाहुकसुतां तदा॥
en: These chiefs sought our protection from the persecution of their relative (Kansa). Having bestowed upon Akrura the beautiful daughter of Ahuka, Satrinka.

sa: तदा शत्रुस्वनं श्रुत्वा भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽनघः। अयाज्जवेन कौन्तेयो रथेनानादयन् दिशः॥
en: The sinless son of Kunti (Arjuna), thus accompanied by his brother, hearing the shouts of the enemy, advanced towards them, filling the whole region with the rattle of the wheels of his chariot.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सत्त्वरूपगुणोपेता धर्मारामा महाव्रता। दुहिता कुन्तिभोजस्य पृथा पृथुलोचना॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The daughter of Kuntibhoja, Pritha, had large eyes; she was endued with beauty and every accomplishment; she was of rigid vows, devoted to virtue; and she possessed every good quality.

sa: कोपादुत्ययात महाबलः। भ्रातृपद्मवनात् तस्मान्मदोत्कट इव द्विपः॥
en: Like a mad elephant the greatly strong Duryodhana rose in anger from among his brothers, who were like an assemblage of lotuses.

sa: कृष्णश्च सुमहातेजाश्चक्रेणारिविनाशनः। दैत्यदानवसङ्घानां चकार कदनं महत्॥
en: That slayer of foes, the greatly effulgent Krishna, also made a great slaughter of the Daityas and the Danavas with his discus.

sa: स हि राजा बृहत्कीर्तिर्धमार्थविदुदारधीः। युक्तः संवरणो भर्ता दुहितुस्ते विहंगम॥
en: He (Samvarana) is a mighty king with great achievements; he is learned in the mysteries of religion and he is high-minded. O ranger of sky, Samvarana is the fittest husband for your daughter.

sa: कच्चिद् राजगुणैः षड्भिः सप्तोपायांस्तथानघ। बलाबलं तथा सम्यक् चतुर्दश परीक्षसे॥
en: O sinless one, do you attend with the six attributes of kings, to the seven means? Do you examine after surveying your own strength and weakness and the fourteen possessions (of your enemies)?

sa: अपरेधुस्तस्याः क्रियतेऽत्युच्छ्रयो नृपः। अलंकृतायाः पिटकैर्गन्धमाल्यैश्च भूषणैः॥
en: After planting the stick, they cover it with golden cloths, perfume it with scents and decorate it with garlands and various ornaments.

sa: यथाकामं यथोत्साहं यथाकालमरिंदम। सेविता विषयाः पुत्र यौवनेन मया तव॥
en: O son, O chastiser of foes, I have enjoyed with your youth to the full extent of my desires and to the full limit of my powers and all according to their seasons.

sa: ततस्तस्यामनावृष्ट्यां प्रवृत्तायामरिंदम। प्रजाः क्षयमुपाजग्मुः सर्वाः सस्थाणुजङ्गमाः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, when that season of draught commenced, all the people together with plants, corns and animals began to die.

sa: ततः श्येनकपोतीयमुपाख्यानमनुत्तमम्। इन्द्राग्नी यत्र धर्मश्चाप्यजिज्ञासच्छिविं नृपम्॥
en: Then follows the beautiful story of the hawk and the pegion; then the trial of king Shivi by Indra, Agni and Dharma,

sa: अष्टक उवाच कतरस्त्वनयोः पूर्वं देवानामेति सात्मताम्। उभयोर्धावतो राजन् सूर्याचन्द्रमसोरिव॥
en: Ashtaka said: O king, who does amongst the two, namely the ascetic and the man of knowledge, first attain to the communion with Brahma, although both exerting like the sun and the moon!

sa: किमागमनकार्य वः किं करोमि समाहितः। आज्ञाप्योऽहं महर्षीणां सर्वकामकरः सुखम्॥
en: What is the reason of your visit? What shall I heedfully perform for you? I am worthy of being commanded by the Maharşis; and I must without demur compass every pleasure of theirs.

sa: ताभिः सह समापेतुर्ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः। ऋतावृतौ नरव्याघ्र न कामाननृतौ तथा॥
en: O best of men, the Brahmanas had connections with them only at their seasons and not when they were not in their seasons and they the Brahmans did not do it with lust.

sa: मेघवृन्दमिवाकाशे विद्धं विद्युत्समावृतम्। तत्र रम्ये शिवे देशे कौरव्यस्य निवेशनम्॥
en: In a delightful and auspicious place stood the palace of those descendants of Kuru (the Pandavas). It was full of every kind of wealth like the palace of the celestials) treasurer (Kubera) himself.

sa: ततो याज्यनिमित्ते तु विश्वामित्रवसिष्ठयोः। वैरमासीत् तदा तं तु विश्वामित्रोऽन्वपद्यत॥
en: At this time Vishvamitra, with whom Vasishtha had a great quarrel on the matter of becoming the priest (of the king Kalmashapada), came to the place (where Vasishtha's son and the king were.)

sa: तं राजसत्तमं प्रीतास्तदा मतिमतांवर। स पितॄणां नियोगं तमनतिक्रम्य पार्थिवः॥
en: And they asked that best of kings and foremost of wise men to kill deer to perform their Shraddha; and the King, thinking that the command of his ancestors should not be disobeyed,

sa: कुमारा रूपसंपन्नाः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदाः। प्रतिविन्ध्यो युधिष्ठिरात्सुतसोमो वृकोदरात्॥
en: These princes were all very handsome and learned in all the Shastras. From Yudhishthira was born Prativindhya, from Bhima was born Sutasoma,

sa: तथा तत् कृतवानग्निरभ्यनुज्ञाय शाकान्। ददाह खाण्डवं दावं समिद्धो जनमेजय॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O Janamejaya, telling them what were his intentions, Agni then accomplished all that the Sharanagakas asked him to do. Growing in strength, he then again began to consume the Khandava.

sa: देवगन्धर्वयक्षाणां नागपार्थिवरक्षसाम्। आदाय सर्वरत्नानि परां तुष्टिमुपागतौ॥
en: Having taken all the wealth of the Devas, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the Nagas, the Rakshasas, the kings, they become exceedingly happy.

sa: अनुक्रमणिकाध्यायं भारतस्येममादितः। आस्तिकः सततं शृण्वन कृच्छ्रेष्ववसीदति॥
en: The believer who always hears this introductory chapter, of the Bharata from the beginning, never meets with any difficulties (in this world).

sa: रजश्चोद्धय सुमहत्पक्षवातेन खेचरः। कृत्वा लोकान्निरालोकांस्तेन देवानवाकिरत्॥
en: The great bird, darkening the worlds with the dust raised by the great storm created by his wings, overwhelmed the celestials. was

sa: कच्चिन्न दुर्बलः शत्रुर्बलेन परिपीडितः। मन्त्रेण बलवान् कश्चिदुभाभ्यां च कथञ्चन॥
en: Are your enemies, especially those that are weak, always repressed by you with the help of your troops? Are those that are strong repressed with the help of both good counsel and troops?

sa: मङ्गल्यं मङ्गलं विष्णुं वरेण्यमनघं शुचिम्। नमस्कृत्य हृषीकेशं चराचरगुरुं हरिम्॥
en: Vishnu, who is pleasing and auspicious one, who is worthy of all worship, pure and sinless, who is Hari, the lord of the faculties, the guide of all the movable and the immovable.

sa: चमूस्तु पृतनास्तिस्रस्तिस्रश्चम्वस्त्वनीकिनी। अनीकिनी दशगुणा प्राहुरक्षौहिणी बुधाः॥
en: Three Pritanas make a Chamu, three Chamus an Anikini and ten times one Anikini is called by the learned as one Akshauhini.

sa: कृतानशनसंकल्पा पत्र भर्तृनुपाविशत्। द्रौपदीवचनाद्यत्र भीमो भीमपराक्रमः॥
en: Sat before her husbands and resolved to die of fasting. Then Bhima of fearful deed, being moved by the words of Draupadi.

sa: यथर्तावृतुलिङ्गानि नानारूपाणि पर्यये। दृश्यन्ते तानि तान्येव तथा भावा युगादिषु॥
en: And at the beginning of other (new) Yugas, all things will be again produced; and like the various fruits of the earth will succeed one another in the dye order of their seasons.

sa: गणात्क्रोधवशादेष राजपूगोऽभवक्षितौ। जातः पुरा महाभागो महाकीर्तिर्महाबलः॥
en: These greatly fortunate, powerful and illustrious and best of monarchs were all born on earth of the race of Asuras, called Krodhavasha.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच युद्धे जितं यशोहीनं स्त्रीनाथमपराक्रमम्। को निहन्याद् रिपुं तात मुञ्चेमं रिपुसूदन॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O chastiser of foes, who would kill an enemy who has been vanquished in the battle, who has been deprived of his fame, who is protected by a woman and who is incapable of defending himself), O child, set him free.

sa: अक्षौहिणीपतीन् दृष्ट्वा भीमसेननिपातितान्। मोहाद् वा यदि वा लोभान्नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: Beholding even a full Akshauhini of troops slain by Bhimasena in battle, the all-destroying battle did not still stop on account of either the folly or the covetousness of the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: सदैव राज्ञा योद्धव्यं सर्वलोकाद् युधिष्ठिर। तस्माद्धेतोर्हि युञ्जीत मनुष्यानेव मानवः॥
en: For the behoof of all his subjects the king should always seek to learn the acts and thoughts of all, O Yudhishthira; and for the reason he should engage spies and secret agents.

sa: स तमुत्सङ्गमारोप्य परिपीडितमानसः। पुत्रं रुधिरसंसिक्तं पर्यदेवयदातुरः॥
en: Taking up on his lap the boy bathed in blood, and the king, with heart stricken with grief, began to lament piteously.

sa: सुखेन धर्मं श्रीमन्तश्चरन्ति शुचिवाससः। संवर्षन्तः फलैर्दानैर्भुजानाश्चान्नमुत्तमम्॥
en: Living with their dear wives the lucky men, cat good food, wear good clothes, and cheerfully acquire virtue by fruits and gifts.

sa: तत्रैतान् पर्युपातिष्ठन् दुर्योधनपुरःसराः। कृताञ्जलिपुटा राजन् काषायमलिनाम्बराः।॥
en: Duryodhana and other heroes, dressed in yellow raiment's, formerly used, O king, to wait reverentially, with joined hands, on those old counsellors.

sa: साहसप्रकृतिर्यत्र किंचिदुल्बणमाचरेत्। अशास्त्रलक्षणो राजा क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति॥
en: That rash king, who, neglecting the injunctions laid down in scriptures, acts with high-handedness in his kingdom, very soon meets with fall.

sa: तदन्तरमथाधृष्यावुपगम्य यशस्विनौ। आस्तामृषिवरौ तत्र ज्वलिताविव पावकौ॥
en: Incapable of being moved by any force, those two great Rishis, placing themselves between the two weapons, stood like two burning fires.

sa: ये केचिद् भूमिपतयः सर्वांस्तानन्ववेक्षयेत्। सुहृद्भिरनभिख्यातैस्तेन राजातिरिच्यते॥
en: A king should, by devoted secret agents, watch the conduct and acts of other kings. By such means can he acquire superiority.

sa: कथं हि राजा लोकस्य सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः। मोहमापद्यसे दैन्याद् यथा कापुरुषस्तथा॥
en: How is it that you who are the king of the world, you who are the master of all branches of knowledge, allow your understanding to be clouded, with depression like a coward?

sa: कृच्छाल्लब्धमभिप्रेतं यदि कौसल्य नश्यति। तदा निर्विद्यते सोऽर्थात् परिभग्नक्रमो नरः॥
en: If, O prince of Koshala, a person loses that wealth which had been acquired with difficulty and after which he had hankered, he then, overcome by despair, gives up all desire of wealth.

sa: प्राणानां धारणार्थाय योऽनं भुक्के चतुर्विधम्। अन्तर्भूतः पचत्यग्निस्तस्मै पाकात्मने नमः॥
en: For supporting the life you eat the four kinds of food. Assuming also the form of Agni within the Stomach, you digest that food. Salutations to you in you form of digesting fire.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्ततो राजंस्तव पुत्रेण धन्विना॥ नाराचैरर्धनाराचैर्बहुभिः क्षिप्रकारिभिः।
en: Then O king, Dhrishtadyumna was quickly cut with many arrows in his arms and chest by your son fighting with his bow.

sa: ब्राह्मणार्थे समुत्पन्ने योऽरिभिः सृत्य युध्यति। आत्मानं यूपमुत्सृज्य स यज्ञोऽनन्तदक्षिणः॥
en: That king, who, going out, fights his enemies in battles that have arisen for the sake of Brahmanas, and sacrifices his life, is regarded as the embodiment of a sacrifice with endless presents.

sa: द्वाविमौ ग्रसते भूमिः सर्पो बिलशयानिव। राजानं चाविरोद्धारं ब्राह्मणं चाप्रवासिनम्॥
en: Like a snake swallowing up mice, the Earth swallows up those two, viz., the king who does not like to fight and the Brahmana who is exceedingly found of his wives and children.

sa: कृतं ममाप्रियं तेन येनायं निहतो मधे। इति वाचा वदन् हन्तुन् पूजयेत रहोगतः॥
en: He that has killed such a hero in battle, has surely done that which I do not like.-Having said so before the survivors of the defeated enemy, the king should in secret honour those amongst his own troops that have bravely killed the foe.

sa: वैरस्य गतमानृण्यं न स्म वाच्या विवक्षताम्। जित्वा मुक्तो द्रोणपुत्रो ब्राह्मण्याद् गौरवेण च॥
